title: Lekalo Adapter SDK Generation Record
description: Closed reproducibility contract (issue #106) of one adapter-SDK generation run: the generator identity and byte digest, the ordered reviewed local inputs with SHA-256 digests, the language/toolchain/options pins, the emitted output relative paths with digests, the compatibility-descriptor digest, and the semantic-validation coverage mapping that names every generated type or explicit bounded hand-maintained codec obligation. The record is deterministic — no host roots, timestamps, secrets, or network facts — and it records build inputs only: it is not proof that a publisher signed a release, that a package passed host trust, or that a runtime qualified outside its own gates.

schemaVersion.description: The wire-format discriminator of this record generation.

identity.description: The stable contract identity of this record generation.

generator.description: The one generator program that produced the run, pinned by exact bytes.

language.description: The one SDK language the run rendered.

toolchain.description: The minimum supported toolchain the generated output targets; an explicit pin, never an ambient local version.

inputs.description: The ordered reviewed local inputs of the run, sorted by path; every entry is content-addressed and resolvable only inside the checkout, never fetched over a network.

role.description: The reviewed role of the input: the pinned protocol schemas, the diagnostic registry, the capability definitions, the generator configuration, or an SDK source the generator inlines verbatim into a standalone template bundle.

options.description: The closed generation option set of the run; absent options are false, never implied.

outputs.description: The emitted generated files, sorted by package-relative path; every digest pins exact bytes so `--check` can detect any drift, including a deliberately stale generated file.

path.description: Path relative to the generated SDK package root (`sdk/<language>/`): generated package modules, the emitted standalone template bundles, or the compatibility descriptor itself.

compatibility.description: The emitted compatibility descriptor of the same run, pinned by exact bytes.

semanticCoverage.description: The coverage mapping of every closed wire definition to its codec obligation: a generated type or an explicit bounded hand-maintained codec, with the shared vectors that prove the obligation. Every envelope definition appears exactly once, sorted by definition.
